meta.title: A vendor session cannot call buyer endpoints
gaps: the plan has the vendor send POST /event_groups, but the supplier app may not call POST /event_groups (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The create_draft operation requires productUuid and productQualityUuid, but the none setup provides no such values.
The exact authorization error code for this request is not specified.

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The invited QA vendor creates a draft event.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
